jmb drippy.bio: JMB Drippy is a Montréal rapper from the Rivière-des-Prairies neighbourhood whose melodic street-rap catalogue includes OK, Ice, Vini Jr and Palmarès. Montréal hip-hop outlet ONZMTL profiled him as a young rapper from RDP, while Quebec music database MUSIQC places him in the province's rap scene. His 2021 collaboration Palmarès with Laval rapper Rach is his Northern Dial library credit.

divine lightbody.bio: Divine Lightbody is a Greater Toronto Area-born Canadian R&B and soul singer, songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist. A finalist on CTV's The Launch, she has developed a Toronto-rooted catalogue blending modern R&B with jazz and gospel influence while collaborating with artists and producers including Xavier Omär and Matthew Burnett. Her 2025 track nightlife with Canadian producer savvan is her Northern Dial library credit.

dario dvon.bio: Dario Dvon is a Barbadian-Canadian R&B and soul vocalist, songwriter, vocal coach and community arts facilitator based in Toronto. Originally from Barbados, he has become active in Toronto's live music scene through performances at Pride Toronto, The Drake Underground and other city venues while blending R&B, pop, soul and Caribbean influences. His feature on Sam-r's 2023 track Leap is his Northern Dial library credit.

fredy v.bio: Fredy V, born Fredy Varre, is a Washington, D.C.-born singer, composer and multi-instrumentalist whose career has been rooted in Montréal since moving there to study music at McGill. He co-founded the Kalmunity Vibe Collective, fronted the Boogie Wonder Band and later led The Foundation, blending funk, R&B, Afrobeats and hip-hop. DIDN'T CHA KNOW, NO TRIBE NO I and PHO THE VIBE from Fredy V & The Foundation's 2025 album account for his three Northern Dial library credits.

chino wawa.bio: CHINO WAWA is a Montréal Afro-pop recording artist whose catalogue blends contemporary pop, R&B and Afro-influenced production. Apple Music identifies Montréal, Quebec, Canada as his origin, and his releases include the GLUE projects alongside collaborations with artists including YessirXD. FLAWS from GLUE ll is his Northern Dial library credit.
